text:
I could not set P-1047's discount to 17%, so nothing was changed.

I signed in, opened the Pricing page, and opened the "Set discount" dialog for P-1047 (Marine Spindle 60). The dialog only offers a slider (0%–60%) with no numeric input. Keyboard presses (ArrowRight, Tab), a click on the track, and a direct action on the slider all left the value at 0%, so I never reached 17%. I then clicked Cancel, so I did not apply anything. The P-1047 row still shows 0%, and I did not touch any other product.

The slider probably needs a different interaction than the ones I tried, or the page has a fault. Someone may need to check it, or give me another way to enter the value.
